items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after 1 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise in sugar about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Most of your dinners, 87.5%, started at 8 pm or later. Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones in the same person.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 12.9 hours, with 50.0% of nights reaching 13 hours. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed HbA1c by -0.03 points compared with coaching alone.
